clips.title: The story
paras: Prospector Ryedol is an Explorers' League surveyor stationed on a dusty rise overlooking the eastern Badlands. Watching over the perilous excavations below, he strives to recover lost dwarven relics and maintain hope in a barren wasteland overrun by troggs and beasts.

Perched upon a rugged hill just south of Hammertoe's Digsite, Prospector Ryedol represents the ongoing efforts of Ironforge's Explorers' League in the Badlands. The arid valley is rich in ancient titan secrets and earthen heritage, but field expeditions here are constantly beleaguered by savage troggs, ravenous coyotes, and territorial drakes. Ryedol coordinates retrieval efforts for dwarven gear stolen by the Dark Iron dwarves and seeks signs of hope amid the ruined outposts, determined not to let the League's sacrifices in the wastes be in vain.
